settings.text:
With over 50+ years of experience in the business of Spices (Masala) production, Wankawala family has taken the legacy forward with a brand VISHESH MASALA under the eminent leadership of Mr. Sundeep Wankawala and Mr. Nilesh Wankawala.

The foundation of Vishesh is based on strong values of simplicity, honesty and the company's dynamic workforce - its biggest asset - that blends a remarkable history and legacy with visionary growth and innovation.

Vishesh Masala has always remained committed to creating uncompromised quality and exceptional taste, and continues to expand its circle of committed stakeholders and ever-growing loyal customer base.

Driven by vision, passion and the desire to create a mark in the world of spices, Vishesh Masala - formerly known as Dhanhar Masala - was incepted from a very humble beginning in the early 70's, founded by a young B.Sc. (Microbiology) and D.T.C. graduate from M.S. University, Vadodara: Late Shri Jagdishchandra Ishwarlal Wankawala.

Initially he joined his family business - a spices shop under the name Dhansukhlal Harkishandas & Sons at Surat - from which the Dhanhar brand was derived.

By delivering excellence in quality products, he grew from strength to strength, achieving one milestone at a time. His discipline, honesty, passion and empathy, ingrained since the early days of his work, reflect even today in the company's culture - and that, we believe, is our constant achievement.

settings.title: Vishesh Vision
settings.text: To become the most opted brand of spices, spice blends and seasonings across every food service segment - retail, wholesale, HORECA and e-commerce - by consistently providing the highest quality, value-for-money products.

settings.title: Vishesh Brand Promise
settings.text: For us, Quality is The GOD - and it is this no-compromise attitude towards quality that gives us the confidence to promise our consumers the Best, and serve them the Purest.

settings.heading: From a home-grown venture to state-of-the-art infrastructure

settings.text:
From a modest home-grown venture to a brand with state-of-the-art infrastructure, cutting-edge machinery and a path-breaking R&D department for unmatched quality - spread over 1,15,155 sq.ft. at Navsari, Gujarat, with 24x7 availability of electricity and water.

Get Directions →

Our story of manifestation of dreams & aspirations started with a small rental production unit in Udhna, Surat - an epicentre of manufacturing. Hing (Asafoetida) was our first product, in a 15 kg tin pack and 5 kg loose.
Expanded infrastructure with another production unit at Katargam, Surat. For the first 5 years, only Hing was manufactured at the facility.

First mover in the market with blended spices. Our first masala was Dalshak Masala - known as Laxmi Chaap Masala in those days - sold in bulk at mom-and-pop shops, delivered the traditional way: by bullock cart.
The young gen-next joined core management as a second line of leadership - Shri Sundeep Wankawala and Shri Nilesh Wankawala.
A major milestone: our first quality certification for Hing & other spices.
Entered consumer packs of 50g, 100g, 200g and 500g. First products under the Dhanhar Masala brand: Hing (now Premium Hing) and Rajwadi Garam Masala.
Introduced the Dealership Model and built a distribution channel, enlarging our product portfolio.
After the split between family promoters of Dhanhar Masala, Shri Sundeep & Shri Nilesh Wankawala - with hard work, experience and sheer values - introduced a new brand: Vishesh Masala.
Shifted manufacturing to Navsari, Gujarat - a state-of-the-art facility with the latest technology machinery.
